run_pytype_benchmark: run pytype on the Acme TensorFlow agents directory and measure type-checking time
test_pytype_repeatability: test pytype type-checking by repeating the benchmark multiple times and collecting timing statistics
summarize_benchmark_times: summarize the average, minimum, and maximum pytype execution times across all benchmark runs
build_pytype_stub_comparison: build a comparison of pytype type-checking time with and without custom stubs installed
review_benchmark_script: review the benchmark script that clones Acme, runs pytype, and reports timing statistics
